name: Visual Data Size
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: TM_DE
description: A client-side fabric mod that displays the exact byte-size and nested tag count of items in advanced tooltips.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Adds the item's serialized size and tag count ('Size: ... (Tags: N)', 'Slot: N B') to item tooltips when advanced tooltips are on; /visualdatasize toggle|slot|tags|format sets it up.
note: Not yet: its settings screen (Mod Menu) and /visualdatasize weren't tried.
